scope: Local saved-prompt provenance and exact context reconstruction for all manifest-selected runs, plus known final-artifact numerical consistency. No inference, network, CODESYS execution or benchmark mutation.
methods: Parsed each initial task message, removing only the exact standard smolagents New task:\n wrapper when present, then compared the full JSON object, including requirements, interface, LTL and fixed expected tests, with its frozen selected task.
Baseline messages exactly matched that run's recorded Agent model_input_messages after the actual transport conversion; compiler observations matched own saved attempts or own compiler-success guard.
Self-harness messages exactly matched reconstruction from its own task, preceding generated candidate and actionable diagnostics; no foreign conversation was supplied.

Scanned all actual message text for other PLC task IDs, foreign condition paths, reference-source path markers, complete foreign task requirement fingerprints and complete Python reference function fingerprints.
Compared known count ratios in actual report PDF text, actual PPTX slide6 text and final encoded-video metadata/source hashes with selected raw rows.
interpretation: No local saved-prompt evidence of cross-run candidate injection or Python reference-answer injection was found. Fixed expected outputs were deliberately visible to both frameworks.
limitations: This provenance/path/text-fingerprint audit cannot prove the absence of semantic leakage, independently identify the original inspiration of a generated algorithm, or inspect hidden remote-provider state or model training data.
Exact context checks concern saved local requests and records; they are not an independent attestation of every remote service operation.

known_final_artifact_consistency.pdf_ppt_rate_precision_note: PDF uses two decimals and PPT uses one; exact numerators/denominators are compared.

audit_notes: The standard smolagents task-message wrapper was checked explicitly against its own stored prompt; it is framework formatting, not additional task or answer content.
